definitions.explanation: The quality of seeming unnatural, forced, or contrived. Describes something that feels off or doesn't flow naturally—applied to behavior, speech, appearance, or situations.

examples.japanese: {不自然|ふしぜん}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不自然|ふしぜん}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: That explanation still has an air of unnaturalness about it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不自然|ふしぜん}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気|き}づいて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Those around him had noticed the forced quality of his smile.

notes:
Formed by adding the suffix さ to the na-adjective ⟦{不自然|ふしぜん}→不自然：11350_fushizen⟧ (unnatural). Nominalizes the quality, allowing it to be treated as a thing that can be felt, noticed, or pointed out. Common in literary writing, criticism, and everyday observations about behavior.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不自然|ふしぜん}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to sense unnaturalness
- {不自然|ふしぜん}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: unnaturalness remains
- {不自然|ふしぜん}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}づく: to notice the unnaturalness
- {不自然|ふしぜん}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: there is no unnaturalness (it feels natural)
- {不自然|ふしぜん}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧: to eliminate the unnaturalness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{違和感|いわかん}→違和感：06249_iwakan⟧: sense of something being off — a subjective feeling that something is wrong or doesn't fit, broader than {不自然|ふしぜん}さ
- ぎこちなさ: awkwardness, stiffness — specifically about movement or behavior that lacks smoothness
- ⟦わざと→わざと：03791_wazato⟧らしさ: deliberate artificiality — implies something is obviously done on purpose to deceive
